The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of visual storytelling, UI animations, product demonstrations, and modern video production techniques, along with the ability to leverage AI tools to improve creativity and production efficiency.
Create engaging product demonstration videos showcasing SaaS features, functionalities, and workflows.
Convert static UI designs, dashboards, and product interfaces into dynamic motion graphics.
Develop product walkthroughs, feature explainers, onboarding videos, and software tutorials.
